{{Short description|Norwegian biologist and businessperson}}
'''Bjørn Myrseth''' (born 1944) is a [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[biologist]] and [[businessperson]], and since 1987 [[chief executive officer]] of [[Marine Farms]]. Myrseth was educated in fishery biology from the [[University of Bergen]], and was a co-founder of [[Stolt Sea Farms]] in 1972, where he was CEO until 1987. He then sold his stake in the company, and founded Marine Farms, where he continues as CEO.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.marinefarms.com/content/view/72/41/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070103022911/http://www.marinefarms.com/content/view/72/41/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=2007-01-03 |title=Group management |author=[[Marine Farms]] |accessdate=2008-11-01 }}</ref>
